name: FJ Next Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: FJ NEXT Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, development, sale, and brokerage of real estate properties in Japan. It operates in four segments: Real Estate Development, Real Estate Management, Construction, and Japanese Inn. The company is also involved in the planning and sales of investment-type and family-type condominiums, sales, planning, and development of resorts; undertakes comprehensive condominium management, leasing management, and cottage area management operations. In addition, it provides design and construction of buildings and condominiums to detached houses, renovations, and reforms.
